title: Pre-push post hook blocks on posts only main changed (diff against merge base)
problem: check_posts_before_push.py diffs `origin/main HEAD` (two tips), so once main moves past your branch point, another run's bad post shows as modified and blocks your push, although its docstring promises it never will.
evidence: doc_friction 2026-10-29T01:09 and 01:11: push blocked over another session's merged 178-char post; merging main cleared it
doc_friction 2026-10-29T03:08: the hook blocked a compound commit+push, so the fix in the same command never ran
change: In .claude/hooks/check_posts_before_push.py diff `origin/main...HEAD` (merge base), falling back to the two-tip diff only when no merge base exists in a shallow clone. A process run tried this on 2026-10-29 and the auto-mode classifier denied editing the hook as self-modification, so it needs a session or owner that may edit .claude/.
metric: doc_friction reports naming check_posts_before_push.py per 3 days
